name: Dutch Housing Centre B.V.
accreditation_number: Jeroen de Bruijn KRMT (MVA Certified Expat Broker)
notes: MVA member (NVM/MVA, in membership since 1976). Dedicated Expat Service and rental search (aanhuren) for internationals relocating to Amsterdam. Reviews confirm repeated placements of expats in Amsterdam rentals. Certified Expat Broker on staff. Handles furnished/part-furnished rentals, sales, and property management.

name: JLG Real Estate B.V.
accreditation_number: Dimitry Jansen RM (MVA Certified Expat Broker)
notes: MVA Certified Expat Broker; confirmed via multiple rental listings hosted on mva.nl. Specialist rental agency (aanhuurmakelaar Amsterdam) with 20+ years experience. Primary focus on tenant-side rental search and property management for expats and internationals in Amsterdam. Rated 9.5/10. Also handles sales.

name: De Graaf & Groot Makelaars o.g.
accreditation_number: Olivier Hoogeveen KRMT; Eppo Henselijn KRMT (MVA Certified Expat Brokers)
notes: MVA member with two Certified Expat Brokers on staff and a dedicated rental specialist (Karina de Leeuw). Full-service rental and sales makelaar at Willemsparkweg 58, Amsterdam-Zuid. Handles rental search and home-finding for expats relocating to Amsterdam.

name: Engel & Volkers Amsterdam Zuid
accreditation_number: Marieke Versloot KRMT & RT (MVA Certified Expat Broker)

name: Ramon Mossel Makelaardij o.g. B.V.

notes: NVM/MVA member with Certified Expat Broker on staff. All-round makelaar in Amsterdam (Arent Janszoon Ernststraat 555) serving expats and internationals for rental and purchase. Known for expat home-finding. English-language service available.

name: Broersma Werken en Wonen

notes: MVA member with Certified Expat Broker on staff. Full-service commercial and residential makelaar at Koningslaan 14, Amsterdam. Handles residential rental and sales; also covers commercial space. Active residential rental listings in Amsterdam.

name: Eefje Voogd Makelaardij B.V.

notes: MVA member with Certified Expat Broker on staff. Large makelaarskantoor at De Boelelaan 7, Amsterdam (Buitenveldert). Primarily known for sales but has active rental department. Capable of expat home-finding. Large team of NVM-registered brokers.

name: Forte Makelaars
